# Parallelized_Hierarchical_Connectome

## Definition
A spatiotemporal recurrent architecture that organizes neural connections hierarchically and processes them in parallel to capture multi-scale dynamics. Enables scalable modeling of brain-like networks in TCC, bridging structural hierarchy with temporal recurrence for efficient in-network computation.
